objective: Add an /orbit handoff operation that turns one validated execution slice into one GitHub issue through the existing orbit sync github adapter, after a dry-run preview, a leak scrub and operator confirmation, and that refuses when the ORBIT CLI is absent or validation fails.
why: The saved reconciliation marks ac1-1, ac1-2 and ac1-3 not-verified, ac1-4 partially-verified, and ac1-6 and ac1-12 contradicted by AgDR-0164. The missing handoff operation is the root gap that most O1 criteria depend on.

include: the handoff operation in the /orbit skill
dry-run preview, then the leak scrub (check-private-refs-runtime.sh), then operator confirmation before any tracker write
issue body with the slice ID, the Plan ID and revision, the objective, and the included and excluded work
refusal when an open issue already carries this slice ID
refusal with one install note when the ORBIT CLI is absent
a new AgDR that partly supersedes AgDR-0164 to permit one issue per slice after confirmation, without rewriting the AgDR-0164 decision text
smoke tests for the handoff and the three refusals
exclude: sidecar mapping file and idempotent re-handoff (ac1-7 to ac1-9)
leak scrub on committed ORBIT records (ac1-10)
